art_direction.concept: The Blueprint to Reality. A single 3D house is the main character, pinned to the background and transforming as the user scrolls. The camera and HTML layout choreograph around it to reveal distinct service chapters.
art_direction.vibe: Award-worthy, highly kinesthetic, architectural, premium, brutalist but refined.

rules: Headings must use tracking-tight to tracking-tighter for a bold, structural look.
Overlines, chapter numbers, and metadata MUST use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
No Inter or Roboto allowed anywhere.
Never center-align paragraphs. Left align to create an editorial grid feel.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise filter (mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20) fixed over the entire viewport to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating UI (like the header navigation or bottom scroll indicators). Use backdrop-blur-xl and a 1px top border.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px structural lines (border-white/10) to divide sections and create a subtle architectural grid.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Apply a subtle radial gradient behind the 3D model to act as a spotlight, drawing the eye to the architecture.

layouts.global_structure: z-0 is the fixed 100vh w-full R3F Canvas. z-10 is the scrolling HTML overlay. The HTML container MUST have pointer-events: none to allow user interaction with the 3D model if needed, but apply pointer-events: auto to text containers, links, and buttons.
layouts.hero: 100vh. Massive typography overlaying the 3D blueprint model. Uses a bento grid or aggressive asymmetry.
layouts.chapters: Each service section must be at least 150vh to give the user enough scroll-time to see the 3D transformation. Use grid-cols-12. Place text blocks in col-span-4 on the far left or right. The position must alternate to choreograph space for the 3D model.
layouts.about_gallery: Switch back to standard DOM flow (or a solid background layer that scrolls over the fixed canvas) to show real photography and testimonials.
layouts.footer: Massive bottom footer. py-32. Border top white/10.

motion.scroll: Lenis MUST be used for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.text_reveals: Use Framer Motion for line-by-line masked reveals on chapter headings. (Wrapper with overflow-hidden, child animating y: 100% -> 0%).
motion.3d_choreography: Map the Lenis scroll progress (via Framer Motion's useScroll) to the 3D model's rotation (y-axis), position (x, y), and scale. As the user scrolls into 'Kitchen Remodels', the model should shift left while the text fades in on the right.
motion.marquee: Include one slow, smooth editorial marquee running in the background of a section: 'OAK PARK CONSTRUCTION • BUILDING LEGACIES •'

3d_libraries.instructions: Since a real GLTF isn't provided, use Drei primitives (<Box>, <Cylinder>, <Extrude>) to build a composite 'Mock House' <group>. The group must contain separate meshes for: The Skeleton, The Finished Walls, The Addition (scales from 0), and The Pergola/Driveway (scales from 0). Use a mesh clip plane or toggle visibility on the front wall for the 'Cutaway' kitchen view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion-3d lucide-react
Create a <Canvas> component that is position: fixed and spans the entire screen behind the content.

Build a modular <HouseModel> component using three.js primitives. It must accept scrollProgress (0 to 1) as a prop to drive its internal states (wireframe to solid, scaling up the addition volume, dropping the front wall).

Create distinct scrolling HTML sections (Hero, Shell Construction, Kitchen Remodel, Additions, Concrete & Pavers). Use Framer Motion useScroll() with an offset (e.g., ['start end', 'end start']) on each section wrapper to know when that chapter is active, and pass that state to the 3D scene.
Number your chapters prominently (01, 02, 03) using JetBrains Mono.
Add a fixed fallback background color (#09090B) in case WebGL is slow to mount.
Ensure the HTML overlay blocks do not obscure the 3D model. If the text is on the left, shift the 3D model to the right via camera or group position.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. The user requested an award-winning, boundary-pushing design.
Avoid simplistic Vercel-like gradients. Rely on high-contrast structural layouts and typography.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never center-align large blocks of paragraph text.
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive and key informational elements.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. In 3D, disable the scroll link and just show a static beautiful model if motion is reduced.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react icons minimally and purposefully.
